ctes.name: invoice_versions
ctes.sql: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, invoice_id ORDER BY source_seq DESC, arrival_seq DESC) AS version_rank FROM DMA_SIM.BRONZE.BILLING_INVOICE_CDC

ctes.name: invoice_current
ctes.sql: SELECT tenant_id, invoice_id, customer_id, CAST(issued_at AS TIMESTAMPNTZ) AS issued_at, CAST(gross_cents AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS gross_cents, COALESCE(CAST(discount_cents AS DECIMAL(38, 0)), 0) AS discount_cents, LOWER(TRIM(status)) AS status, currency FROM invoice_versions WHERE version_rank = 1 AND op <> 'DELETE'

ctes.name: payment_versions
ctes.sql: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, entry_id ORDER BY source_seq DESC, arrival_seq DESC) AS version_rank FROM DMA_SIM.BRONZE.BILLING_PAYMENT_CDC

ctes.name: payment_current
ctes.sql: SELECT tenant_id, entry_id, invoice_id, CAST(amount_cents AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS amount_cents, LOWER(TRIM(status)) AS status, currency FROM payment_versions WHERE version_rank = 1 AND op <> 'DELETE'

ctes.name: credit_versions
ctes.sql: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, entry_id ORDER BY source_seq DESC, arrival_seq DESC) AS version_rank FROM DMA_SIM.BRONZE.BILLING_CREDIT_CDC

ctes.name: credit_current
ctes.sql: SELECT tenant_id, entry_id, invoice_id, CAST(amount_cents AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS amount_cents, LOWER(TRIM(status)) AS status, currency FROM credit_versions WHERE version_rank = 1 AND op <> 'DELETE'

ctes.name: posted_payments
ctes.sql: SELECT tenant_id, invoice_id, currency, SUM(amount_cents) AS payment_cents FROM payment_current WHERE status = 'posted' GROUP BY tenant_id, invoice_id, currency

ctes.name: posted_credits
ctes.sql: SELECT tenant_id, invoice_id, currency, SUM(amount_cents) AS credit_cents FROM credit_current WHERE status = 'posted' GROUP BY tenant_id, invoice_id, currency

ctes.name: customer_history
ctes.sql: SELECT tenant_id, customer_id, CAST(valid_from AS TIMESTAMPNTZ) AS valid_from, CAST(valid_to AS TIMESTAMPNTZ) AS valid_to, segment FROM DMA_SIM.BRONZE.BILLING_CUSTOMER_HISTORY
